title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones, S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher With Eyes On Iran Talks—Apple, UnitedHealth, 3M In Focus
author: Benzinga Staff Writer
description: U.S. stock futures rose on Tuesday following Monday's decline, with major indices edging higher. Markets are focused on U.S.-Iran negotiations in Islamabad and Kevin Warsh's Fed Chair confirmation hearing. Key stocks in focus include Apple (CEO transition), UnitedHealth (earnings expected), 3M (earnings expected), Amazon (Anthropic partnership expansion), and Spruce Biosciences (stock offering announcement).

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Tim Cook stepping down as CEO in September 2026, though John Ternus succession is planned. Stock declined 0.60% in pre-market. Maintains strong price trend but leadership transition creates uncertainty.
Earnings expected at $6.58 per share on $109.58B revenue. Stock rose 0.65% in pre-market. Maintains strong price trend over short, medium, and long terms.

title: Rare Endocrinology and Metabolic Disorders Market Analysis: Emerging Trends and Future Outlook of Hypophosphatasia, Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia, and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia | DelveInsight
author: Delveinsight
description: The article discusses the rare endocrinology and metabolic disorders market, focusing on hypophosphatasia, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and severe hypertriglyceridemia. It highlights the challenges faced by patients, the current treatment landscape, and the pipeline of emerging therapies.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: AstraZeneca (Alexion Pharmaceuticals) is the developer of STRENSIQ, the first-line therapy for hypophosphatasia, which has been approved by the FDA.
Neurocrine Biosciences is developing a pipeline therapy, Crinecerfont, for congenital adrenal hyperplasia.
Spruce Biosciences is developing a pipeline therapy, Tildacerfont (SPR001), for congenital adrenal hyperplasia.
Crinetics Pharmaceuticals is developing a pipeline therapy, Atumelnant (CRN04894), for congenital adrenal hyperplasia.
BridgeBio is developing a pipeline therapy, BBP-631, for congenital adrenal hyperplasia.
Ionis Pharmaceuticals is developing a pipeline therapy, Olezarsen, for severe hypertriglyceridemia.
Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is developing a pipeline therapy, Plozasiran (ARO-APOC3), for severe hypertriglyceridemia.
89bio is developing a pipeline therapy, Pegozafermin (BIO89-100), for severe hypertriglyceridemia.
